lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: Morning everyone. The only topic today is the beta launch.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: I think the build is stable enough. We should ship the beta on Friday.

lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: Agreed, we ship on Friday. Maria will update the pricing page before that.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Great. I will send the release notes to the whole team by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: We also decided to drop the dark mode toggle from this release.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Fine by me. Carlos can you check the crash reports on Windows?

lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: Sure, I will look at the Windows crash reports tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Let's review the backend hiring loop. We have three candidates left.

lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: The second candidate did really well on the system design interview.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Then the decision is to make her an offer this week.

lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: Okay. I will prepare the offer letter and send it to legal on Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: And I will schedule a reference call with her last manager.

lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: Bom dia. Vamos fechar o escopo da próxima sprint.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Eu acho que o login com Google precisa entrar nessa sprint.

lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: Concordo. Então fica decidido que o login com Google entra.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Eu vou escrever os testes do fluxo de pagamento até sexta.

lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: E o Pedro vai revisar o contrato com o fornecedor de hospedagem.
